name: W New York - Union Square
insider_take: This edgy Union Square hotspot pulses with NYC energy, where downtown creativity meets uptown sophistication in one of Manhattan's most dynamic neighborhoods.
whats_special: The W New York sits atop one of the city's most historic and vibrant public squares, where the famous Greenmarket has operated since 1976. The hotel's Living Room bar is a legendary nightlife destination that helped define the boutique hotel scene in the early 2000s, while the building itself occupies prime real estate where Broadway, Park Avenue, and 14th Street converge.
pro_tip: Visit the Union Square Greenmarket on Monday, Wednesday, Friday, or Saturday for the freshest local produce and artisanal goods - it's right outside your door and frequents by top NYC chefs.
dont_miss: The rooftop views of the iconic Union Square Park statue and the hotel's proximity to the Strand Bookstore (18 miles of books!), plus you're just steps from the subway hub that connects you to anywhere in the city within minutes.
pros: Prime Union Square location with easy access to shopping and dining
Stylish modern design with trendy W Hotels signature atmosphere
Vibrant nightlife scene with rooftop bar and social spaces
Excellent connectivity to subway lines and major NYC attractions
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Manhattan hotels
Busy urban environment with street noise
